clue.text: Skin healing — starts to show courage and bravado

indicators.note: the starts of the next four words are their opening letters, which are taken together

explanation.surface: Advice to a recovering patient to put on a brave face while the skin mends.
explanation.definitionFit: A crust of dried blood forms over a wound while the skin underneath repairs itself.

clue.text: Hate losing heart after fight? A quiet tip

indicators.note: the shortened word comes after the word for a fight in the down light

parts.note: a scrap is a fight or brawl

indicators.note: the word Hate loses its central letters, its heart, leaving its first and last

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone who hates a brawl gets a hushed piece of advice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing heart' strips AT from the middle of HATE, leaving HE. 'tip' looks like advice, but it is a rubbish tip; in Britain a tip is a dump.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubbish dump where unwanted junk is thrown away is a tip in British usage.

clue.text: Pub profit on cellar through cheap offers

indicators.note: in a down light one piece written on another sits above it, so the first pair goes over the cellar

parts.note: a bar is a pub or the counter in one
gain means profit
a basement is a cellar, the floor below ground

explanation.surface: A publican boosts profits by selling cut-price goods from the cellar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'through' is a link word joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The bargain basement is the lower floor of a store where reduced goods are sold cheaply, so it stands for such deals.

clue.text: Notice given to quartet regarding sleeping arrangement

indicators.note: the notice is handed on after the quartet, so it follows it

parts.note: a quartet is four of anything
a poster is a notice put up in public

explanation.surface: Four people are handed a notice about where they will sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regarding' is a link word joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed with tall corner columns, often curtained, is a grand place to sleep.

clue.text: New menu inside has to stimulate

parts.note: fresh means new

indicators.note: the inside of the word menu is its middle pair of letters

explanation.surface: A new menu arrives that is meant to whet the appetite.
explanation.definitionFit: To revive or invigorate something is to stimulate it, as a breeze does to someone tired.

clue.text: Make economies? It's no good

explanation.surface: A thrifty person is told that cutting back is pointless.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, USE LESS means make economies; as one word it means no good. 'It's' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Consuming less is economising, and something of no use or value is worthless.

clue.text: Stones — best make running repairs here

parts.note: pits are the stones of fruit such as cherries
top means best, as in top marks

explanation.surface: Stones are said to be the best place to fix things on the go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running repairs' are quick fixes made during a race, and the definition names the place where they happen.
explanation.definitionFit: In motor racing, cars pull into a trackside bay mid-race for refuelling, tyre changes and quick fixes.

clue.text: Flight engineers last race is Paris

indicators.note: to engineer is to contrive or construct, so the letters of the following words are rebuilt

explanation.surface: Engineers say the final race takes place in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' looks like air travel, but here it is a flight of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of stairs winding round a central column is a helical staircase.

clue.text: Peak offering free return for example

parts.note: to rid is to free of something

indicators.note: a return turns the abbreviation back to front, which reads upwards in this down light

explanation.surface: A mountain summit is offered as a free trip back, as an example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns EG into GE.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow raised crest of hills or mountains forms a peak along its top.

clue.text: Dog with no tail — get back!

indicators.note: the dog's name loses its last letter, its tail

parts.note: a retriever is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: An owner shouts at a tailless dog to come back.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a dog with a docked tail being called back, which fits the retriever's job of fetching.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover or fetch something is to regain it.

clue.text: Worked hard (until one was ahead)

parts.note: to means until, as in nine to five
I is the Roman numeral for one
led means was ahead, as in a race

explanation.surface: Someone laboured away until they took the lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Labouring with great effort is toiling.

clue.text: Compound used for grass when harvesting starts

parts.note: grass and pot are both slang for cannabis
as means when, as in as he arrived

indicators.note: starts picks the opening letter of the word harvesting

explanation.surface: A farm compound used on the grass once the harvest begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used for' is a link word joining the definition to the wordplay; 'Compound' suggests an enclosure but is the chemical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium carbonate and related potassium salts used in fertiliser form a chemical compound.

clue.text: Opening spell

explanation.surface: A spell that opens something.
explanation.walkthrough: Stressed on the first syllable it is a way in; on the second it means to put under a spell.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorway is an opening, and to enchant or bewitch someone is to cast a spell on them.

clue.text: A reminder to get in line?

definitions.text: A reminder to get in line?

parts.words: A reminder to get in line?
parts.note: reads like an order to queue up, but means the prompt an actor hears before saying the next line of a script

explanation.definitionFit: A prompt given to a performer as the signal to speak or enter is a reminder of when to act.

clue.text: Times when one's still at home with guests outside

parts.note: even means still, as in even better or still better
in means at home

indicators.note: the outside of the word guests is its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Quiet nights in when guests come round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when one's' and 'with' are link words; 'Times' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Late parts of each day after work, when many people stay in, are periods of time.

clue.text: Quietly steal off into the shade

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

indicators.note: off means wrong or bad, so the letters of the word steal are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thief slips quietly away into the shadows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges STEAL as ASTEL. 'shade' suggests shadow but means a colour; 'into the' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, pale colour such as baby blue is a gentle tint.

clue.text: The type of character found in a minor lawsuit

parts.note: lower means minor or lesser
a case is a lawsuit brought in court

explanation.surface: A small legal action reveals what sort of person someone is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'type' and 'character' sound like personality, but refer to printing: small letters as opposed to capitals.
explanation.definitionFit: Small letters, as opposed to capitals, are a kind of printed letter, named after the lower tray of a printer's type.

clue.text: Delight in having rental agreement on parking

indicators.note: in an across light a piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
a lease is a rental agreement

explanation.surface: Someone is thrilled to have a tenancy that includes parking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in having' is a link word joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To delight someone is to gratify or satisfy them.

clue.text: Defendant's request to be executed in field

indicators.note: executed here means beheaded, so the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a plea is what a defendant enters or asks of the court

explanation.surface: A condemned defendant pleads to be put to death in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'executed' is read as beheaded: off comes the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic word for a meadow or pasture.

clue.text: Divorcee, for example, on summer in France, became a biblical scholar

indicators.note: in a down light the first pieces written on the last sit above it

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse, such as a divorcee
ete is the French word for summer

explanation.surface: A divorced person holidaying in France one summer turned to studying the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'became a' is a link word joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who interprets and explains scripture is a Bible expositor.

clue.text: Stop permit to get rid of lake house

parts.note: a bung is a stopper for a hole

indicators.note: the word for permit must lose the letter for lake

parts.note: allow means permit
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: An order to stop a lakeside house from being knocked down.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-storey dwelling is a type of home.

clue.text: Throw up and blubber seeing the post

indicators.note: up turns the word for throw upside down in this down light, reading it backwards

parts.note: to lob is to throw high
lard is fat, and blubber is fat

explanation.surface: Someone vomits and sobs on seeing the letter from the morning post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LOB into BOL. 'seeing the' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A short thick upright post, often on a quay or roadside, is a stout bollard.

clue.text: Money put aside for awfully tense horse

indicators.note: awfully suggests something done badly, so the letters of the word tense are rearranged

parts.note: gee-gee, GG, is a childish word for a horse

explanation.surface: Savings lost on a horse that made the owner very nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' rearranges TENSE as NESTE. 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Savings set by for the future are a reserve fund.

clue.text: Plant a resistance fighter in the outskirts of hull

indicators.note: in places the article and the fighter inside the letters from the edges of the word hull
the outskirts of the word hull are its first and last letters

parts.note: a rebel is someone who fights against authority

explanation.surface: An undercover resistance fighter is planted on the edge of the city of Hull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a verb, but is the definition, a flower. Hull is a city in northeast England.
explanation.definitionFit: A bluebell-like wildflower with drooping blue bell-shaped flowers is a plant.

clue.text: Stags need suit to be loud

indicators.note: loud means spoken out, so the word for a suit is said aloud

parts.note: hearts is one of the four suits in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: Male deer need a loud suit to attract attention.
explanation.walkthrough: In non-rhotic British speech the card suit and the male deer sound the same; 'need' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Male red deer, especially adults over five years old, are known as stags.

clue.text: One starts to play tennis on the computer

explanation.surface: A player beginning a tennis match on a computer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the' only joins. The first sense is the player who starts each point by hitting the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis the player who begins a point serves; a machine that supplies files and services to a network is a host computer.

clue.text: Flower arrangement people put before the compiler

indicators.note: the people come before the setter's self-reference in the answer

parts.note: a race is a people or nation
a setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A setter puts a floral display before the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower arrangement' sounds like a vase of blooms, but is the botanical term for how flowers grow on a stem.
explanation.definitionFit: In botany, the way flowers sit on stalks along a single main stem is a type of inflorescence.

clue.text: Prayer books worrying non-Catholic America

parts.note: AV is the Authorized Version, the King James Bible

indicators.note: worrying suggests troubling or disturbing, so the letters are rearranged
C is the abbreviation for Catholic, so the word America loses that letter

explanation.surface: A Catholic prayer book is upsetting to non-Catholic Americans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'non-Catholic' drops the C, leaving AMERIA, which 'worrying' rearranges into EMARIA. The Ave Maria is the Latin Hail Mary.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hail Mary is a Catholic prayer to the Virgin.

clue.text: Saw setter getting sweet

parts.note: spotted means saw or noticed
a setter is a breed of dog

explanation.surface: A crossword setter is seen eating a pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter' looks like the crossword compiler, but is the gun dog. A spotted dog is a British steamed suet pudding with currants.
explanation.definitionFit: A British suet pudding studded with currants is served as a dessert.

clue.text: Nick a boundary

explanation.surface: Stealing a boundary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' suggests stealing, but in cricket a nick is a thin touch off the bat; 'a' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A batter's slight touch off the bat in cricket is a nick, and the border of anything is its limit or margin.
